notes.title: We are part of the "Games Against Living Miserably" Steam Event
notes.content: [h3]From 8–15 September, marking World Suicide Prevention Day, nearly 200 games are coming together on Steam to support mental health as part of Games Against Living Miserably 2025. [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/71faaaf18cbc721cf34e6460a5ce89f10abcb5ad.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]We’re excited to have our upcoming game Glintseeker Island included – you can already add it to your wishlist![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25" style="button"]Click here to visit the Steam Event[/url][/h3][p][/p][p]The event is presented by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital"][b]Curve Games[/b][/url] and the suicide prevention charity [url="https://www.thecalmzone.net/"][b]Campaign Against Living Miserably[/b][/url][b].[/b] By taking part, we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re truly grateful to join such an important campaign and proud to stand alongside so many other developers, publishers and creators in support of mental health.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h3]

notes.title: GlintLog #002 - New overgrown biome
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Glintseekers ⛏️[/h3]

[b]After a month of hard developing, we have some exciting game updates.[/b]

[h3]The updates:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Worked on the second biome, where the overgrowth has take over. You'll encounter new new Enemies and new features in the Mining Mingame there.🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/80920f9a01d3ec80271cdbb4ca6ad9706a64e6aa.gif[/img]

[*] The Ice Hammer has been given new abilities – you can now freeze dirt, rocks and vines, making them easier to break. ❄️

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/f5d28ae44dc80e16124087ec1579c51011470842.gif[/img]


[*] We also composed a new theme for the "Overgrown Biome" - we are curious to see what you think of the new music in our Demo (Coming soon!). 🎵
[/list]

[i]In our GlintLog #003 you can expect even more updates, like new rooms, new animals and new features.
[/i]
Stay tuned!

[h3]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h3]

notes.title: We exhibited at the MAG-C Festival - and came 2nd!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Glintseekers! [/h2]

Last weekend we had the opportunity to exhibit our game at MAG-C. 
So first of all, thank you to everyone who was there and played our new demo. 
We received lots of positive feedback and many of you shared good ideas which we are now implementing into our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/8dd4d830146e20c5e8b595fb1353e3265d9ed75c.jpg[/img]
[b]To our excitement, we were also nominated for the MAG-C's Game Award Ceremony and came 2nd in the categories "Best Game Design" and "Audience Favourite" behind the great game PVKK. 
This has been incredibly motivating and we are more excited than ever to work on Glintseeker Island.[/b]

A huge thank you to the organisers of MAG-C and all the other indie developers with their amazing games we got to meet and share ideas and experiences with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/bdf5b59496dde87d39f5db62d4f13da5e0685eb6.jpg[/img]
[b]Our next convention stops are:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Baltic Games Fest: 11.04.-12.04.   [/b]
[*] [b]Gamescom[/b]
[/list]
See you there! 

If you have any ideas or feedback, let us know in the comments or discussion section ❤️

[h2]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h2]

notes.title: GlintLog #001 - New features for our mining mechanic! ⛏️
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello fellow Glintseekers ⛏️ [/h2][/b]

[i]*This is the beginning of our new series "[b]GlintLog[/b]" in which we will regularly tell you what we are currently working on.*[/i]

[h3]Todays [b]GlintLog #001 [/b] is about new features in our mining game![/h3]

[b][h3]The updates:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] We implemented an [b]obsidian layer[/b], that is much more durable than other layers. It also features small golden spots that reward you with karat when breaking them. 🟡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/a6fec7990a4f6b3702e2624df688fb8f0fe611a0.gif[/img]

[*] A [b]diamond gemstone[/b] you can insert in your pickaxe to make quicker work of the obsidian layer. 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/d60459d35ba77e2a5edc919d4a4a063044372e03.gif[/img]

[*] And a [b]vines layer[/b] for the new overgrown biome (which we are working on) 🌳. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/d4fe46d1b72ebcd2933e03137ca49cc69fe79c26.gif[/img]
[/list]

If you have any ideas or feedback, let us know in the comments ❤️
 
[h3]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h3]
